newsitem.title: USA: Computer Integration to sell big stake.
newsitem.headline: Computer Integration to sell big stake.

text.p: Computer Integration Corp said Friday it had agreed to sell 6.95 million common shares -- just short of a 50 percent interest in the company -- to a non-affiliated party for $7.4 million.
After the sale, the buyer will own 49.86 percent of the common stock outstanding, or 44.94 percent assuming exercise of options, warrants and other convertible securities, CIC said.
CIC will also issue to the buyer a seven-year warrant to purchase an additional 300,000 shares at $1.13 per share, the company said.
The closing market price for CIC common stock was 1-1/8 on May 15.

Conditions of the deal include the receipt by CIC of a fairness opinion from its investment banker, Principal Financial Securities, the completion by the buyer of due diligence, and the receipt by the buyer of financing, the company said.
